notes: Makes the folder's new files encrypted, with key, the next version of the folder's key (one more than key_version, or 1), made on the admin's device: signed by the root (contract/crypto/sign.json: share-e2ee-v1/sign/folder-key, folder:<id>:<version>, its public key), its private key sealed for the admin's person key and for the recovery key (share-e2ee-v1/folder, folder:<id>:<version>); everyone else who sees the folder gets it through the to-do list. Turning it on again after it was off makes a new version too. Or plain again: {"encrypted": false, "plain_signature": the root's plain statement for the folder's newest version and its name (share-e2ee-v1/sign/plain)}; the encrypted files stay readable, and phones and browsers send plain only with that signature. Answers the folder as GET /api/folders does. Errors: 400 bad_request (on without key, off with one), 400 bad_signature (a signature that doesn't verify under the newest root), 409 key_outdated (someone made that version a moment ago), 409 no_key (no recovery key yet: PUT /api/recovery first), 404 not_found.
